decision.rationale: REAL: falsifiable candidate registered as challenger council_the-aegis-mt5-demo-bot-is-running-the-in_87c6da for the validation pipeline

proposals.text: Test a stricter validated-state candidate that requires two consecutive qualifying bars before admitting a signal. Replay it on the same sealed holdout with identical spread/slippage assumptions and compare net expectancy, trade count, and maximum drawdown against the current champion. Accept it for further consideration only if net expectancy improves by at least 10%, maximum drawdown does not worsen, and trade count remains at least 70% of baseline; otherwise reject and record the result in the ExperimentRegistry.

question: The AEGIS MT5 DEMO bot is running the intelligent firehose with the validated-state gate. Given the current measured evidence, identify ONE concrete, falsifiable improvement candidate for the next research cycle. Do not modify code or the champion. Cite book corpus passages if relevant.
